comment: kiln.rules: per-player rules where the game decides them (docs/re/rules.md). Every pattern matches the dedicated server and the game client once (svn 1287369), so the client uses this file unchanged.

rules/FlyGate.comment: player_control_action_sequence: where 'may this player be in building fly mode' (bl) has been decided; the mid hook goes on the merge point after it

@rules/FlyGate.actor.comment: the same program tests IsNearBuildingZone (54) on its Actor slot: the slot's rbp displacement and the game's state test

@rules/FlyGate.entity.comment: the same program reads the current entity id into the frame before the gate

rules/ZoneFlag.comment: server_cursor_no_prediction: right after IsInBuildZone(BuildZoneSystem, cursor position) returns (al), before it becomes ServerCursor.serverFlags IsNearBuildingZone (bit 2, +0x69); r12 holds the ProgramContext (the CurrentEntityId call right after takes it)

rules/CursorFlags.comment: the build cursor's refusal flags (keen::ecs::CursorFlag bits): server_cursor_no_prediction and client_cursor call it for the primary and secondary action; its context starts with the ProgramContext

rules/ShroudDrain.comment: fog_resistance_update: the fog-type dispatch (movzx ecx, bl) after the safe-zone override; r15 = ProgramContext, bl = fog type (2 dangerous, 3 deadly drain FogResistance and run the death check), r13w / r12w = the current / max value slots, [rsp+fog.attr] = FogResistance, [rsp+fog.actor] = Actor

@rules/ShroudDrain.delta.comment: the deadly-fog branch reads the actual step duration before multiplying its drain by 100; the floor guard uses the same duration

find.pattern: 48 8D 95 ?? ?? 00 00 49 8B CF E8 {rules/StepDelta:rel32} 48 8B 4D D0 0F 57 C0 0F 57 F6 F2 48 0F 2A 00 F2 0F 59 C7 66 0F 5A C8 F3 41 0F 59 C9

@rules/ShroudDrain.attr.comment: the same program keeps its FogResistance component pointer at [rsp+fog.attr] (tested for its valid bit +6)

@rules/ShroudDrain.state.comment: the same program clears InFog (bit 13) in the Actor's state word first: its offset

find.pattern: 48 8B 44 24 ?? 48 81 A0 {rules/fog.state:d32} FF DF FF FF 48 8B 4D ?? 48 85 C9 74 ??

rules/GlideStep.comment: locomotion_execution's glide step (LocomotionState HangGliding 4), void(iterator*): the glider's thrust and drag on Velocity, in substeps; iterator +0 = ProgramContext; the died / hit event lists are checked first

@rules/GlideStep.abort.comment: the glide step's abort path hands its ActorInput slot to the abort function

@rules/GlideStep.xform.comment: the glide step turns (0,0,1) by the CurrentTransform's rotation (QuatRotate(float3* out, const Quaternion*, const float3*)) after reading the step's time (StepDelta(ctx, int64* out) -> ns)

find.pattern: E8 {rules/StepDelta:rel32} F2 44 0F 10 ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? 4C 8D 44 24 ?? 49 8B 56 {rules/glide.xform:d8} 48 8D 4C 24 ?? 0F 57 C0 F3 0F 11 74 24 ?? F2 48 0F 2A 00 48 83 C2 {rules/xform.rotation:d8} F2 41 0F 59 ?? 66 44 0F 5A F8 0F 57 C0 0F 14 C7 F2 0F 11 44 24 ?? E8 {rules/QuatRotate:rel32} 49 8B 9E {rules/glide.dynloco:d32}

@rules/Loco.input.comment: locomotion_execution's PlayerInput slot (null for anything but a player) and the stick it reads

find.pattern: 48 8B 47 {rules/loco.player_input:d8} 0F C6 F6 C9 0F 29 74 24 ?? 66 0F 7F 74 24 ?? F2 0F 11 44 24 ?? 48 85 C0 74 ?? F3 0F 10 80 {rules/input.stick:d32} F3 44 0F 10 88

@rules/Input.mask.comment: PlayerInput's digital-input mask (the held bits, u64, follow at +8; Sprint = bit 53)

@rules/Input.trigger.comment: the abort of an action (the glide's too): ActorInput's trigger u16 = 24 (ExternalAbortAndOverride)

@rules/Input.stick.comment: the player control program after player_control_building_fly_mode (server 0xcd6c1, client 0x2e1721), unless the actor is Dead: ActorInput.desiredLocalMoveInput (+0x18c, float3) = (movementStick.x, 0, movementStick.y), PlayerInput.fromClient.movementStick (float2 at PlayerInput+0x2c0) - the stick's y is the local forward axis (W +1, S -1). Pins rules/input.stick (a second capture beside @rules/Loco.input) and that y is forward, for the boosted glider's pitch

@rules/Input.camera.comment: player_deflect_parried_projectiles turns (0,0,1) by the player's camera orientation (PlayerInput.fromClient.camera, a Quaternion) before reading fromClientSettings.attackDirectionInput: the camera's forward, which a boosted glider takes its pitch from

find.pattern: 48 8B 5D ?? 4C 8D 85 ?? ?? 00 00 F2 0F 10 35 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 8D 8D ?? ?? 00 00 8B 35 ?? ?? ?? ?? F2 0F 11 B5 ?? ?? 00 00 48 8D 53 {rules/input.camera_rot:d8} 89 B5 ?? ?? 00 00 E8 {rules/QuatRotate:rel32} 0F B6 8B {rules/input.attack_dir:d32}

rules/GlideGravity.comment: gravity_apply_velocity_actor: after the gravity strength (xmm6, PlayerLocomotion's rising/falling override) is chosen, at lea rdx / mov rcx,rdi before StepDelta; rdi = ProgramContext, the Actor at [rbp + (int8)grav.actor]

rules/GlideStamina.comment: stamina_depletion_glider: this step's drain in xmm6 just before it is added to StaminaDepletion (mov rax,[rbp-0x78]; addss xmm6,[rax]); rdi = ProgramContext

rules/ApplyMaterials.comment: takes (r8 1) or gives (r8 0) a building action's materials list {ptr, count} of 0x18-byte entries (item +0x10, count +0x14) through the cost context's inventory transaction (+8; mode byte +0)

rules/TerrainDamage.comment: damage of one terraforming hit on one material: setup[hardness] x the server's miningDamageFactor x the class modifier -> {u8 error; u32; float damage}
